_comment: Registry of installed SmartPole nodes. lat/lon = the pole's GPS position. approx_view_m = roughly how much road the camera sees (width, height in metres), entered at installation; used only for the 'uncalibrated estimate' of size until the pole is calibrated. The coordinates below are EXAMPLES near VIT-AP: replace them with the real GPS of each pole when it is installed. POLE01's approx_view_m is the prototype setup: a camera on a rod looking at an A3 sheet (about 45 x 35 cm in view).

POLE01.name: Pole 1 (prototype node)
POLE01.address: Example location: VIT-AP campus road (replace with the real pole position)
